key: Uaaaaweeh! Raising Pokémon is so much work...
en: Uaaaaweeh! Raising Pokémon is so much work...
ja: うわあああ! ポケモン育てるのって大変すぎ……

key: I was given this Pokémon, but no way I'm raising this stupid pink thing.
en: I was given this Pokémon, but no way I'm raising this stupid pink thing.
ja: このポケモンもらったんだけど、こんなバカなピンクの奴、育てる気にならないんだよね。

key: I really just want an evolved Pokémon, something simple to use. Like, Bibarel.
en: I really just want an evolved Pokémon, something simple to use. Like, Bibarel.
ja: ほんとは、もう進化してて使いやすいポケモンが欲しいんだよ。ビーダルみたいなさ。

key: If you have a Bibarel, want to trade it for this thing?
en: If you have a Bibarel, want to trade it for this thing?
ja: ビーダル持ってるなら、こいつと交換しない?
やってくれんの? やった!
\PNはビーダルとムンナを交換した!
マジ助かるわ。サンキュー!
交換してくれてありがとな!

key: Gotta say, I'm learning how to really spend time on Pokémon for the first time.
en: Gotta say, I'm learning how to really spend time on Pokémon for the first time.
ja: 実はさ、初めてポケモンとちゃんと時間を過ごすってことを学んでるんだ。

key: I was always so focused getting them to the level I wanted, I forgot to appreciate spending time with them!
en: I was always so focused getting them to the level I wanted, I forgot to appreciate spending time with them!
ja: ずっと欲しいレベルまで上げることばっかり気にしてて、一緒に過ごす時間の大切さを忘れてたよ!
